task_inventory.name: Create project directory tree
task_inventory.objective: Create the two top-level Python packages (`app` for application code, `tests` for the test suite) and a `.gitignore` covering Python build artefacts, the virtual environment created in L0-004, and the SQLite database file created in L4-001.

task_inventory.name: Create app subpackages
task_inventory.objective: Create the three subpackages of `app` that layers 3 and 4 write into -- app.models, app.api and app.schemas -- each with a package marker so it is importable before any module lands in it.

task_inventory.name: Declare Python dependencies and pytest config
task_inventory.objective: Write pyproject.toml declaring the project metadata, the four runtime dependencies (fastapi, sqlalchemy, pytest, httpx), the explicit setuptools package list, and the pytest configuration -- all in one file.

task_inventory.name: Install dependencies and verify the environment
task_inventory.objective: Create a virtual environment at .venv, install the project and its four declared dependencies into it in editable mode, and prove the environment works: fastapi, sqlalchemy and httpx all import, the `app` package imports from the installed distribution, and pytest runs to completion.

task_inventory.name: Define Link request and response schemas
task_inventory.objective: Define the two Pydantic v2 models that carry link payloads over HTTP: LinkCreate for the request body of POST /links, and LinkRead for the response body of POST /links and GET /links. LinkCreate's url validation is the mechanism L3-003 later relies on to produce 422 for save-link criteria 3 and 4, and it must reject before any database session is touched - which it does by construction, because FastAPI validates the request body before the handler function is entered. This task builds the mechanism only; it asserts neither criterion, and L3-003 is where both are tested end to end.

task_inventory.name: Create FastAPI application and links router
task_inventory.objective: Create the FastAPI application object in app/main.py and an empty APIRouter in app/api/links.py, wire the router into the app, and prove with a smoke test that the application imports and serves. This establishes the two module paths - `app.main:app` and `app.api.links:router` - that every remaining backend task writes against.

task_inventory.name: Implement POST /links
task_inventory.objective: Add the POST /links route handler to app/api/links.py. It accepts a url and an optional title, stores one Link row, and returns 201 with the generated integer id, the submitted url, the title (null when none was supplied) and a created_at timestamp. A payload with no url, or with a url that is not an absolute http or https URL, is rejected with 422 by the LinkCreate schema before the handler runs, so nothing is stored.

task_inventory.name: Implement GET /links with optional tag filter
task_inventory.objective: Add a GET /links handler to app/api/links.py that returns every stored link as a JSON array ordered most recently created first, accepts an optional tag query parameter that filters to exactly the links carrying that tag, and returns 500 rather than an empty array when the stored links cannot be read.

task_inventory.name: Define tag attach request and response schemas
task_inventory.objective: Create app/schemas/tag.py defining the Pydantic request model for attaching one or more free-text tag names to a link, and the Pydantic response model reporting a link together with every tag attached to it.

task_inventory.name: Implement POST /links/{link_id}/tags
task_inventory.objective: Add a POST /links/{link_id}/tags handler to app/api/links.py that attaches one or more free-text tags to an existing link and returns 200 with the link reporting every tag attached to it, leaves an already-attached tag attached exactly once when it is posted again, and returns 404 without creating any tag rows when the link id does not exist.

task_inventory.name: Create SQLAlchemy declarative base and session factory
task_inventory.objective: Create app/db.py: the SQLAlchemy 2.x declarative Base that every model in this project subclasses, a file-backed SQLite engine with foreign-key enforcement switched on, a session factory, an explicit init_db() that creates the schema with Base.metadata.create_all, and the get_db FastAPI dependency that yields a session and closes it afterwards.

task_inventory.name: Create Link model
task_inventory.objective: Create the SQLAlchemy model `Link` in app/models/link.py - the entity save-link owns and the one every other feature reads - and export it from app/models/__init__.py so that `Base.metadata.create_all` actually creates the `links` table.

task_inventory.name: Create Tag and LinkTag models
task_inventory.objective: Create the two models tag-links owns: `Tag` in app/models/tag.py and the `LinkTag` join table in app/models/link_tag.py, with a composite primary key over (link_id, tag_id) that makes a tag attachable to a link exactly once, and export both from app/models/__init__.py.

task_inventory.name: Create pytest fixtures for database and TestClient
task_inventory.objective: Create tests/conftest.py providing two fixtures - `db_session`, a SQLAlchemy session against a fresh empty SQLite database created per test, and `client`, a TestClient for the FastAPI app with get_db overridden to yield that same session - so that every backend test runs against an isolated database and never touches the real link_shelf.db.
